description: I am responsible for me ; I am self sufficient and reliable. #selfdiscovery #confidence #selfsufficient
transcript: Self-sufficiency has led me to a life centered and sustainability. Sustainability has taught me that I am responsible for my internal world and I cannot outsource the responsibility of being myself. I have to keep my hands on the wheels at all times. Stillness continues to shift my perspective and I do not have to live for others' validation and understanding. I do not have over extend my hand reaching for validation and I'm comfortable with me.
